requirement_rows.noticing_target: Across rising, apex and falling states, v_x stays constant, signed v_y passes through zero, and g remains downward.
requirement_rows.instructional_purpose: Separate the changing velocity state from acceleration and make the apex a component event rather than a stop event.
requirement_rows.translation_obligation: Translate the staged trajectory picture into rising/apex/falling words, then signed v_x/v_y symbols, then v_x(t)=u_x and v_y(t)=u_y-g t.

requirement_rows.noticing_target: Instantaneous direction follows the current signed component pair; the sign of v_y distinguishes rising from falling direction.
requirement_rows.instructional_purpose: Prevent reuse of the launch angle and force direction to be reconstructed from the current velocity state.
requirement_rows.translation_obligation: Translate the tangent/component picture into direction language, then v_x/v_y/phi symbols, then the quadrant-resolved relation phi=atan2(v_y,v_x).

requirement_rows.noticing_target: Speed is the nonnegative hypotenuse of signed components; at the apex the vertical leg vanishes while the horizontal leg remains.
requirement_rows.instructional_purpose: Separate scalar speed magnitude from component signs and block the zero-speed-at-apex misconception.
requirement_rows.translation_obligation: Translate the component triangle into magnitude language, then v_x/v_y/v symbols, then v=sqrt(v_x^2+v_y^2) and v_apex=|v_x|.

requirement_rows.noticing_target: At equal heights the two states share v_x and |v_y|, reverse the sign of v_y, and therefore share speed but not velocity direction.
requirement_rows.instructional_purpose: Distinguish scalar same-height symmetry from equality of the velocity vector.
requirement_rows.translation_obligation: Translate the paired trajectory points into comparison words, then signed component pairs, then v_y,fall=-v_y,rise together with equal-speed magnitude.

requirement_rows.noticing_target: The two nonzero velocity vectors must be identified in one common frame and their right-angle relation involves both signed component pairs.
requirement_rows.instructional_purpose: Replace the one-component-zero shortcut with the general vector condition for perpendicularity.
requirement_rows.translation_obligation: Translate the perpendicular arrow picture into right-angle language, then two component pairs, then u_x v_x(t)+u_y v_y(t)=0.

requirement_rows.noticing_target: The target state is anchored to a declared height origin, keeps the horizontal component unchanged, and derives the vertical component from displacement rather than time.
requirement_rows.instructional_purpose: Support height-based speed reasoning without origin drift, unnecessary clock solving, or loss of the horizontal contribution.
requirement_rows.translation_obligation: Translate the trajectory and height marker into target-state words, then y/u_x/v_y symbols, then v_y^2=u_y^2-2gy and v^2=u_x^2+v_y^2.
